A '''soldier''' served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]] in around [[3629 BBY]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the [[Imperial soldier]] attended to [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] onslaught on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

The Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] sported short [[Color/Legends|black]] hair and fair skin. When receiving orders from or reporting to Malgus, the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] displayed subordination to his superior, sharply straightening to attention or bowing his head down.

The Human wore standard Imperial soldier [[Armor/Legends|armor]] where the color gray was replaced by black, and had neither a helmet nor a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. While he was unarmed, the Imperial had a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] device attached to the left ear.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We've finished here. Rally the surviving troops outside.''"<br />"''Yes, my lord!|Darth Malgus and the soldier in the Imperial storyline|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>}}
The Imperial soldier appears in the [[2018]] "Jedi Under Siege" update to the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] digital expansion of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the Imperial storyline.

Since elements of the Imperial storyline contradicting the Republic storyline are [[Forum:CT:The Old Republic: Commander's storyline affiliation|assumed]] to be non-canon, contradictory information is detailed in the section below. Since the Imperial storyline involves the player being an Empire-allied character, it is also [[Forum:CT:TOR and video game canon|assumed]] that the player always chooses options that result in maximum dark side points, when available. Since the Republic storyline of ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' is [[Forum:CT:The Old Republic: Commander's storyline affiliation|assumed]] to be canon, [[Darth Vowrawn]] is assumed to be the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the reconstituted Sith Empire in the following.

===Non-canon biography===
{{Quote|My lord! Incoming broadcast from Emperor Vowrawn!|The soldier reports to Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the Invasion of Ossus in 3629 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], where the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] joined forces with the [[Eternal Alliance]], Imperial forces were led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malgus. As Malgus and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the Alliance [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] and defeated the [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]] at the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]], the soldier led four other troopers to the site. After Darth Malgus [[Death/Legends|executed]] Gnost-Dural, the Imperial soldier was ordered by the Sith Lord to rally other surviving troops outside the [[Library/Legends|library]]. The soldier snapped to attention and complied, using his comlink on his [[Ear/Legends|ear]] as Malgus and the Commander left with the other four troopers.

Outside the library ruins, Imperial troops were being rallied by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]] when Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] retaliated, breaching Imperial [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] defenses and with [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] targeting the Imperial camp. Seeing that the attack would not overturn the Empire's victory over enemy morale with the killing of Gnost-Dural, Malgus ordered that all forces return to the central [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial command base]] on Ossus at once. As forces gathered outside the Jedi ruins retreated, the Imperial soldier ran after the group, eventually reaching the command base.

Hearing news of Gnost-Dural's death, Emperor Vowrawn contacted Darth Malgus through [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. When Malgus and the Commander entered the Imperial Ossus command base's briefing room, the soldier bowed his head and reported to Malgus that the Emperor was waiting for a holo-communication. While Malgus and the Commander spoke with Vowrawn, the Imperial soldier operated a [[Computer/Legends|console]] by the hologram. He continued to do so after the transmission with Vowrawn terminated, as Malgus gave parting words to the Commander before leaving Ossus per Vowrawn's command.

====Alternative paths====
When the player has defeated Gnost-Dural, the player could chose to spare the Jedi instead of having him killed. If he is spared, Darth Malgus would order the Imperial soldier to take the Jedi away in addition to rallying other surviving troops.
